map.依据 ISBN 校验规则：ISBN-10 按 mod-11 加权校验（校验位可为: Per ISBN rules: ISBN-10 uses mod-11 weighting (check digit may be X), ISBN-13 uses mod-10 alternating 1/3 weighting; supports mutual conversion between 10- and 13-digit.

map.前 12 位按 1,3,1,3… 加权求和，校验位 = (10 - 和 mod: The first 12 digits are weighted 1,3,1,3… and summed; check digit = (10 − sum mod 10) mod 10. E.g. 978-3-16-148410-0: weighted sum then tens-complement gives check digit 0. Old ISBN-10 uses the mod-11 algorithm.
map.978 是图书传统前缀，979 为新分配段；前缀不同占用不同号段，书号解析时需按: 978 is the traditional book prefix, 979 the newly allocated range; different prefixes occupy different number ranges, and book-number parsing follows EAN rules.

map.ISBN-13 是 EAN-13 兼容的 13 位（含 978/979 前缀），: ISBN-13 is the EAN-13-compatible 13-digit (with 978/979 prefix), check uses weighted 1/3 mod 10; the old ISBN-10 is 10-digit, mod 11 (last may be X). New books use 13 digits.
map.校验位有什么用？: What is the check digit for?
map.快速发现扫描/手输书号的一位错或多数换位错，避免录入脏数据；不验证书是否真实存在: Quickly catch a single-digit or most transposition errors when scanning/typing a book number, avoiding dirty data; it does not verify the book really exists.
